segments.text:
V. 2.
As thou haſt given him power over all fleſh—This anſwers to Glorify thy Son. That he may give eternal life, &c. This anſwers to That thy Son may glorify thee. To all whom thou haſt given him—To all Believers. This is a clear Proof, that Chriſt deſigned his Sacrifice ſhould avail for all; yea, that all fleſh, every Man, ſhould partake of everlaſting Life. For as the Father had given him power over all fleſh, ſo He gave Himſelf a Ranſom for all.
